name: attribution-replication
cmd: set -e; for spec in desk_tempho_1995_s1:E022/desk-tempho1995-seed1-f946971f1b3e:desk_tempho_1995_seed1 desk_tempho_1995_s2:E022/desk-tempho1995-seed2-aeb2bee5efae:desk_tempho_1995_seed2 desk_tempho_1985_s1:E022/desk-tempho1985-seed1-581ee4a21fc2:desk_tempho_1985_seed1 desk_tempho_1985_s2:E022/desk-tempho1985-seed2-945e69ec063c:desk_tempho_1985_seed2; do IFS=: read -r cc run ov <<< "$spec"; {python} research/exp/backcast_attribution.py --cache {cache}/$cc --run-dir {outroot}/$run/desk --overlay research/overlays/$ov.json --out {out}/$cc; done
summarize: for d in {out}/*/; do {python} research/exp/backcast_attribution.py --summarize $d; done
